summary: First-pass full e2e testing of Montage Events rebuild. Backend: all 14 pytest tests passing (root, bookings CRUD, admin verify, admin list, admin delete with token guards). Frontend: homepage loads, all 6 service cards + form fields + WhatsApp link present, Service Sheet opens on card click, navigation anchors exist, contact form successfully POSTs to /api/bookings (status 200) and clears after submit, admin route shows login/rejects bad token/accepts montage2026/lists bookings/logout works. No console errors except the expected 401 from a deliberate bad-token attempt.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in modern FastAPI; prefer lifespan context manager. Non-blocking.
Booking POST returns 200 (Booking model) instead of 201 Created; works but 201 is more conventional for resource creation.
Admin auth is a static shared token from .env passed as a header - acceptable for this simple admin panel but not suitable for multi-user/production scaling.

Form 'missing-name' toast: validation works (no POST fires when invalid in code path) but sonner toast disappears quickly so could not capture text in headless run; consider data-testid on toast container for better testability.
Hero section heavy; ensure images are lazy-loaded for performance (most look like remote URLs which is OK).
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed bookings during automated tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend covered by /app/backend/tests/test_montage_api.py (14 tests, all pass). Auto-cleans TEST_ rows. Frontend critical flows (service sheet, booking POST, admin login/dashboard/logout) verified via Playwright on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Form event-type is a native <select>. Sonner toaster is present at body level but auto-dismisses fast.
